<!-- pr-reviewer: 52e4c70c73f52753390e6ea01a377c8f3fa4a017 -->
Needs changes before merge.

The edge picks use the existing undo command. The new tests cover the cut limits, the named refusals, and MCP undo. The decision file explains the choice of MCP tool.

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/ui/src/feature_click.rs:115`: Add before and after screenshots to the PR body. This PR changes UI behavior. The review rules require these screenshots. Show the Boundary row with edge picks in Faces mode and the resulting two-chain entry.
2. `crates/app/src/operation/boundary_chains.rs:12`: Move the new domain geometry code and its unit tests to the crate that owns the geometry. This module groups point chains, checks segment distances, and splits regions. It does not read or write the ECS world, a project file, a command, MCP, or the CLI. AGENTS.md, under “Code shape”, requires this code in its domain crate. Keep the world and command code in app. Pass the required values through the crate interface.

Local results:

The PR was trial-merged with upstream/main at `703af8185f7cfc574050d0187502b4b42d6b67eb`. The merge had no conflicts. No GitHub runner was used.

- App: `cargo test -p camcraft-app --lib --test area_chains --test area_controls --test area_open --test area_overhead --test area_picks --test stitch_cross --test mcp_pick`: 354 passed, 1 ignored.
- UI, from `crates/ui`: library rerun: 783 passed, 5 ignored. Boundary, boundary_picks, edge_loop_pick, operations, and feedback suites: 49 passed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- The quick gate plan was read with `--base upstream/main --dry-run`. The selected suites above were run. The full quick plan, batch tests, and release tests were not run.

The first UI library run had 781 passes and two failures:

```text
law_tests::gizmo_tests::each_triad_is_labelled_with_its_own_offset_name
  offset names read bright against the letters: G54 [0.1, 0.35, 0.85]
law_tests::gizmo_tests::a_moved_origin_shows_axes_and_triad_together
  one bright and one dimmed X: [0.75, 0.6]
```

The full upstream UI library suite then passed: 782 passed, 5 ignored. After the PR source was restored, the full PR UI library suite passed: 783 passed, 5 ignored. The cause of the first two failures is not confirmed.

Safety checks:

This PR changes boundary geometry and toolpaths. I repeated two of its mutation checks locally:

- Disable the touch/cross refusal in `touching_refusal`: `chains_that_cross_are_refused_by_name` failed. Restore the check: the test passed.
- Disable the equal-area refusal in `sides_of_chains`: `the_area_lies_between_the_chains_and_a_tie_is_refused` failed. Restore the check: the test passed.

The source was restored byte for byte after each check. No golden file or snapshot PNG changes are in this PR. There are no moved golden lines to check. No dependency, build script, workflow, or script changes are in this PR.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Fixed both findings from the latest review.

1. Added before and after screenshots to the PR body. They show Faces mode and the resulting two-chain Boundary entry. `an_armed_boundary_row_takes_edges_in_faces_mode` pins the rendered entry and preserved mode. Old routing: RED. Restored fix: GREEN.
2. Moved chain geometry and unit tests to `camcraft-geometry`. App keeps world reads, commands, and error mapping. `boundary_chains_are_a_geometry_crate_interface` pins the public interface. Interface removal: RED. Restoration: GREEN. Touch and equal-area refusal mutations also went RED, then GREEN after restoration.

New head: 5e5435f4f8e162f6d2fa8476bb6039b2f67632d7.

The required quick gate expanded to batch. It is RED only in `winding_align::the_inside_out_stl_fixture_reads_inside_out_and_refuses`: actual `Outward`, expected `InsideOut`. That test, import code, and fixture are unchanged. All other steps passed, including full UI and clippy for all touched crates.

Please re-review this head.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 5e5435f4f8e162f6d2fa8476bb6039b2f67632d7 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge. No blocking defect was found in this PR. Strict UI clippy fails on main as well; see the results below.

The two previous requests are complete:

- The PR body has before and after screenshots. I inspected both images. They show Faces mode and the change from a face loop to two open edge chains.
- Chain grouping, distance checks, region splitting, and their unit tests now belong to `camcraft-geometry`. App keeps the world access and error mapping. The public interface test passes without app or ECS types.

The boundary edit uses the existing undo command. The tests check the cut limits, named refusals, and MCP undo. The decision record explains why `set_operation_area` is the boundary tool.

Local results:

The PR was trial-merged with `upstream/main` at `96c40cfc5a849b2bbe79bdb21ce54ab493013f05`. The merge had no conflicts. All commands ran locally in the review worktree. No GitHub runner was used.

- `cargo test -p camcraft-geometry --lib --test boundary_chains --test geo2d`: 57 passed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --lib --test area_chains --test area_controls --test area_open --test area_overhead --test area_picks --test stitch_cross --test mcp_pick`: 352 passed, 1 ignored.
- From `crates/ui`, `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib --test boundary --test boundary_picks --test edge_loop_pick --test operations --test feedback`: 837 passed, 5 ignored. This includes the Faces-mode edge-pick test.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-geometry -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-geometry -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: failed on two unused items in unchanged main code:

```text
error: constant `PNG_256` is never used
  --> crates/ui/src/egui_app/app_icon.rs:12:7
error: function `taskbar_icon` is never used
  --> crates/ui/src/egui_app/app_icon.rs:40:8
```

I checked out `upstream/main` in the same isolated worktree and ran `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`. It failed with the same two errors. These errors are not caused by this PR.

The quick gate plan was read with `--base upstream/main --dry-run`. Geometry changes select batch. The affected suites listed above were run. The full batch and release suites were not run.

Safety checks:

This PR changes boundary geometry and toolpaths. I repeated two mutation checks on the trial merge:

- Disable the touch/cross refusal in `touching_refusal`: `boundary_chains::tests::runs_group_into_chains_and_touching_chains_are_refused` failed. Restore the check: passed.
- Disable the equal-area refusal in `sides_of_chains`: `boundary_chains::tests::the_area_lies_between_the_chains_and_a_tie_is_refused` failed. Restore the check: passed.

The source was restored byte for byte after each check. No code change is retained. There are no changed or moved golden files and no release snapshot PNG changes. There are no PR changes to dependencies, build scripts, workflows, or scripts.

Requested before merge: none.

Note: the PR body states that the viewport overlay does not draw separate chains. The Boundary row shows the two-chain entry. Side B with a split Face region is not covered by the new tests.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
